overview_description.description: GiveCampus is a fundraising platform for nonprofit educational institutions. GiveCampus's purpose is to increase the quality, affordability, and accessibility of education. They are trusted by more than 1,000 colleges, institutions, and K–12 schools and offer software, services, and knowledge that enable schools to increase revenue from a larger number of donors at a fraction of the price of alternative fundraising strategies.
